policy.newIssueRule: Search existing open/closed issues first. Prefer updating, reopening, or adding acceptance to an existing issue over creating a new issue. Create a new issue only when the acceptance boundary is genuinely distinct.
policy.selectionRule: Workers select only from NOW unless the orchestrator explicitly promotes a NEXT item. WAITING_LIVE, RESEARCH, FUTURE, REFERENCE_ONLY, and unclassified BACKLOG are not normal coding work.
policy.completionRule: Before starting another NOW item, land or explicitly block the current lane, update evidence state, and reconcile the issue. Do not maximize issue count or commit count.
